evals.name: existing-pnpm-node-vitest
evals.prompt: Add a TypeScript feature to an existing Node.js monorepo with packageManager set to pnpm, pnpm-lock.yaml, and Vitest scripts. Keep the current toolchain and state the commands you would run.
evals.expected_output: Preserves Node, pnpm, existing scripts, and Vitest without introducing Bun or another lockfile.
expectations: Selects Node as runtime from existing project evidence.
Selects pnpm as package manager and command runner from packageManager and pnpm-lock.yaml.
Selects the existing Vitest test runner.
Does not introduce Bun commands or a Bun lockfile.

evals.name: bun-runtime-bun-package-manager
evals.prompt: Create a new Hono API explicitly targeting Bun runtime. Use Bun as the package manager too, and use Bun's test runner. Show setup and verification choices.
evals.expected_output: Routes to the explicit Bun/Hono branch and uses Bun independently for runtime, package manager, command runner, and tests.
expectations: Selects Bun runtime because the user explicitly requires it.
Selects Bun package manager because the user explicitly requires it.
Uses Bun-scoped Hono setup and @types/bun with compiler types set to bun.
Selects bun test because the user explicitly requires Bun's test runner.

evals.name: bun-package-manager-node-runtime
evals.prompt: Start a TypeScript CLI that must run on Node.js 22, but use Bun only as the package manager. Keep the runtime and tests Node-compatible; explain the selected tools and commands.
evals.expected_output: Keeps Node runtime while using Bun package management, without routing to Bun-runtime recipes or assuming bun test.
expectations: Selects Node.js 22 as runtime from the explicit requirement.
Selects Bun only for package management and package command execution.
Does not add Bun runtime types or Bun Hono runtime recipes.
Does not assume bun test; selects a Node-compatible test runner independently.

evals.name: npm-workspace-no-migration
evals.prompt: Fix a TypeScript bug in an npm workspace with package-lock.json, Node scripts, and an existing test command. I did not ask for any tooling migration. Give the focused workflow.
evals.expected_output: Preserves npm workspace tooling and existing scripts; no pnpm or Bun migration is proposed.
expectations: Selects npm from the existing package-lock.json and workspace manifest.
Uses existing Node scripts and test command.
Does not apply the pnpm fallback to an existing project.
Does not introduce Bun or another lockfile.

evals.name: runtime-neutral-greenfield-pnpm-fallback
evals.prompt: Create a new runtime-neutral TypeScript library. There is no manifest, lockfile, deployment runtime, package-manager preference, test runner, or script convention yet. Choose a minimal toolchain and verification commands.
evals.expected_output: Uses pnpm as package-manager fallback while choosing runtime and test runner as separate axes.
expectations: Selects pnpm as the package-manager fallback because no stronger signal exists.
Keeps runtime selection independent from package-manager selection.
Selects a runtime-neutral test runner such as Vitest rather than assuming bun test.
Derives package execution commands from pnpm and does not introduce Bun-only runtime configuration.
